full_name: Lisa A. Crooms-Robinson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Law Marilyn Beaudry-Corbett Schlesinger Fellow Howard University
bio: Lisa A. Crooms-Robinson is a law professor and the interim dean of Howard University School of Law. She works at the intersection of law, identity, and rights as matters of both domestic and international law.
